heard: Akrotiri is the Pompeii where nobody died. Volcanic ash buried the city, though the exact date remains debated. In 1967, Spiridon Maranatos began excavating the volcanic debris. He found three-story buildings and colorful frescoes. Unlike Pompeii, no human remains were found. Preceding earthquakes likely warned the population to flee. The people escaped leaving behind a ghost town.
